poses.caption: Lie supine with legs extended, arms at sides and heels on the floor.
Lift the hips with legs long, keeping shoulders, head and heels supported.
Slide both heels toward the glutes with hips lifted; extend slowly and lower the hips.

jobs.detail: SUPINE FLOOR SLIDING HAMSTRING CURL, THREE equal SQUARE panels in one WIDE LANDSCAPE row. Same SIDE three-quarter camera, HEAD LEFT FEET RIGHT. No bench/equipment/sliders, plain floor. Skull DIRECTLY rests on floor throughout, eyes ceiling, neutral relaxed neck, hair flattened away from under skull. Arms at sides palms flat floor unchanged. LEFT: supine start full back/pelvis on floor, both legs extended long, heels on floor, toes up. CENTER: bridge with BOTH legs long almost straight, hips lifted off floor, heels stay planted far away, upper shoulders and skull grounded, body shoulder-hips-knees-heels near straight low inclined line. RIGHT: draw BOTH heels along floor TOWARD glutes, knees now bent near 90 degrees with shins near vertical and feet flatter, hips stay lifted, body shoulder-hips-knees aligned, upper shoulders/skull grounded. Heel positions clearly move from FAR away center to CLOSE right, both feet floor contact, pelvis rises slightly as knees bend, no legs floating/no thighs pulled chest/no extreme lumbar arch. Primary HAMSTRINGS ONE smooth diffuse blurred red tint over posterior thighs on opaque black shorts, no fibers/rays in fabric; exposed calves/arms detailed grayscale. Same model scale and shoulder/head fixed floor position across phases.
jobs.prompt: Correct original project THREE-panel supine floor sliding hamstring curl. Keep same side view head left feet right, same model and SAME SCALE, identical head/shoulder anchored locations in each square cell. LEFT start long legs/pelvis floor, CENTER long-leg bridge heels far away, RIGHT curled bridge. CRITICAL RIGHT panel heels must visibly slide toward hips, move BOTH shoes LEFT toward hands so heel is approximately one forearm length from fingertips, knees bend90degrees over heels; do not elongate torso or change thigh/shin lengths to keep feet far away. Maintain normal same limb lengths across all poses, same fixed skull/shoulder positions, hips lifted only center/right. Skull DIRECTLY on floor, eyes ceiling neutral neck, flatten hair behind head not under skull. Palms grounded same place. Replace red shorts fiber streaks with ONE smooth diffuse BLURRED red teaching tint over continuous opaque matte BLACK posterior thigh fabric, erase every ray/anatomical division, broad natural folds only. Preserve fine detailed grayscale EXPOSED arm/calf muscles and all full opaque garments front sides rear seat crotch. Whole body in three square cells with margins. No text/equipment.
jobs.inspectionNote: Correction moves curled-phase heels closer to hands/glutes and replaces cloth streaks with smooth diffuse red. Three supine phases, grounded head/shoulders/palms and lifted hips in bridge phases retained. Exposed anatomy remains grayscale, opaque full garments. Qualified heel-slide continuity, limb scale, knee range and lumbar/hip alignment review pending.

poses.caption: Support on the forearm and stacked bent knees, lift the hips into a straight line from knees to head, and hold 20–30 seconds before switching sides.

jobs.detail: BENT-KNEE SIDE BRIDGE ISOMETRIC, ONE static hold full-body SIDE three-quarter FRONT view. Lie on LEFT side and support LEFT FOREARM flat on thin gray mat, elbow directly under left shoulder, forearm points ahead, left hand relaxed flat. BOTH knees BENT together about90degrees and STACKED on mat, BOTH lower legs/feet extend BACK BEHIND knees, shoes visible. Lift HIPS off mat until straight line LEFT KNEE-HIP-SHOULDER-HEAD, torso long diagonal, no side bend/sag. Ground support ONLY left forearm plus bent left knee/shin, NOT toes. RIGHT arm rests hand on right hip, top elbow points up naturally. Both legs remain knees bent stacked, no top leg raised. Neck neutral aligned spine eyes forward, full body/shoes/hands within wide margins. Primary ABS one smooth diffuse BLURRED red tint over side/front abdominal region of intact black shirt, no rays/fibers/sixpack divisions in garment. Exposed arms/calves fine detailed grayscale anatomy; all opaque shirt/shorts front sides back seat crotch. No bench/ball.
